spec.name: Orange Kitchen Chicken Fried Rice
spec.description: A deep, stepped terracotta ceramic bowl filled with soy-seasoned rice, golden cooked chicken and translucent onion, finished with paired wooden chopsticks. Rounded bowl corners, a thick glazed lip and generous toppings keep the silhouette readable in inventory.

prompt: Orange SMP Kitchen cohesive premium Minecraft vanilla voxel art. Appetizing recognizable silhouette and deliberate connected pixel shading, material detail and highlights. No plain untextured cubes, random noise, letters or scenery. Use ONE well-mapped 64x64 atlas; per-face UV islands, not repeated generic material tiles. Keep texture palette cohesive: warm golden bread, fresh greens, ivory rice, rich salmon, warm ceramics. Geometry should be carefully stepped and rounded where appropriate, with purposeful tiny details. 20-55 cuboids as appropriate, stay within Java model bounds -16..32. Item ground bottom y0. Strong inventory readability. Create Chicken Fried Rice. Deep glazed ceramic ramen/rice bowl, visible noodles or rice, discrete appropriate ingredient toppings and chopsticks. Actual recipe ingredients: cooked rice, cooked chicken, soy sauce, onion. Let the visible appearance reflect these ingredients.
